about.title: About KomikNest
about.body: KomikNest is a free comic reading platform that only publishes original works, public-domain works, and works whose license allows redistribution. Every title shows its license and source.
about.creatorsBody: Have a comic you'd like to publish on KomikNest? Get in touch — you keep your rights, and we credit and link to your channels.
about.reportBody: If you believe any content infringes copyright, send us a report with the link. We'll review and take it down promptly.

footer.rights: All works belong to their respective creators.
